mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a full bathroom renovation in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a full bathroom renovation in the East Bay area can range widely, typically from $20,000 to $50,000 or more, depending on the scope and finishes. Factors like the size of the bathroom, the quality of materials chosen, custom features, and any structural or plumbing reconfigurations significantly impact the final price. High-end fixtures, custom tile work, or relocating plumbing lines will increase costs. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
